title: Admit Triton as an optional governed multi-backend inference-serving provider
decisions: Triton is a replaceable serving/runtime provider under the existing inference-portability profile and does not add a capability or architectural authority.

The hardened default model-control mode is none for immutable startup projections; explicit is permitted only for Model Manager-authorized dynamic lifecycle operations; poll is forbidden for production.
The Triton model repository is a non-authoritative runtime projection of admitted model state, mounted read-only by default.
Accelerator visibility must equal the Host Resource Broker grant and model instance placement must remain within that grant; --gpus all and implicit device fallback are forbidden.
Production runtime identity requires an admitted immutable container digest; a release tag or upstream commit alone is insufficient.
HTTP, gRPC and metrics bind to loopback by default and external access is mediated by the canonical gateway/security boundary.
Triton metrics are observability inputs, not canonical evidence; deployment receipts are appended through the existing evidence authority.
Static CI evidence cannot promote current-host production status; a real current-host E2E run remains required.
